name: quite-admin-docs
description: English and Russian documentation for quite-admin, built with Diplodoc

scripts.docs:build: node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/diplodoc.cjs build -i docs -o build/docs --strict && node scripts/prepare-pages.mjs
scripts.demo:test: node --check demo/app.js && uv run --no-sync python scripts/build_demo.py && node --test tests/demo.test.mjs tests/schema.test.cjs tests/filters.test.cjs
